Aisha Patel: Quick sync — scheduling a 90m Power-User Labs for NovaHealth next week to cover Dedicated migration + billing mapping. Need a timezone-friendly plan and facilitators. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00 PT / Wed 16:00 CET / Thu 09:00 SGT. Thoughts? @Marco @Jin @Lina :calendar:
Marco Ruiz: Wed 16:00 CET works for EMEA but that’s rough for APAC. Tue 10:00 PT covers NA. Do we run two sessions or try one global?
Jin Park: Two sessions probably safer. I can lead the APAC-friendly Thu 09:00 SGT demo. Need slide deck + demo env access. Lina, can you own pre-reads?
Lina Gomez: Yup — I’ll make a 1-pager + checklist. Will post in the shared drive. Can we use the sandbox project `nova-ded-prod-sim` for demo (link to follow)?
Samir Kapoor: I’ll handle invites/calendar. Also suggests a 30-min pre-recorded walkthrough customers watch beforehand to save live time. @enablement-bot can you queue a recording to the Enablement playlist?
enablement-bot: Recording queued: "Power-User Labs — NovaHealth primer". Upload ETA 24h. :white_check_mark:
Aisha Patel: Fine — two sessions it is. Action items: Lina = 1-pager, Jin = demo setup, Marco = co-facilitate NA/EMEA + metrics slide, Samir = invites + recording. Target slots: Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 PT (NA) and Thu 2026-04-09 09:00 SGT (APAC). Also please add renewal-risk notes to the CS portal before sessions.
Marco Ruiz: Works for me. I’ll add a short "renewal risk" slide and pull usage/latency metrics for the week. Recommend capping to 12 customers per session or create breakout rooms.
Lina Gomez: I’ll drop the doc at /drive/enablement/novahealth/poweruser-v1.pdf and post the link here when ready.
Jin Park: I’ll provision the demo env tonight and include quick connection notes in the doc. Quick warmup suggestion for demos:
```
python warmup.py --model=redwood-2-small --length=128
```
This primes the KV cache to avoid cold latency spikes.
Samir Kapoor: Invites created — calendar invites sent to NovaHealth contacts + CS team. Recording link attached in the invite. :thumbsup:
Aisha Patel: Perfect — thanks all. I’ll follow up 24h before to confirm facilitators and attendee list. Tag me if anything changes or if we need to swap slots.
